# mxroute_catch_all (Data Source)

Read the existing catch-all routing setting. Non-address modes expose a null address, clearing stale values. Unavailable settings are errors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_catch_all" "routing" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned canonical domain.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Forwarding destination, null outside address mode.
- `description` (String)
- `type` (String) fail, blackhole, or address.
